faces.name: Tezzeret's Betrayal
faces.oracleText: Destroy target creature. You may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Tezzeret, Master of Metal, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.

faces.name: Tezzeret's Gambit
faces.oracleText:
({U/P} can be paid with either {U} or 2 life.)
Draw two cards, then proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

faces.name: Tezzeret's Gatebreaker
faces.oracleText:
When this artifact enters, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a blue or artifact card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
{5}{U}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Creatures you control can't be blocked this turn.

faces.name: Tezzeret's Reckoning
faces.oracleText: Exile three random cards from your library face down and look at them. For as long as they remain exiled, you may play one of those cards.

faces.name: Tezzeret's Simulacrum
faces.oracleText: {T}: Target opponent loses 1 life. If you control a Tezzeret planeswalker, that player loses 3 life instead.

faces.name: Tezzeret's Strider
faces.oracleText: As long as you control a Tezzeret planeswalker, this creature has menace. (It can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)

faces.name: Tezzeret's Touch
faces.oracleText:
Enchant artifact
Enchanted artifact is a creature with base power and toughness 5/5 in addition to its other types.
When enchanted artifact is put into a graveyard, return that card to its owner's hand.

faces.name: Tezzeret the Schemer
faces.oracleText:
+1: Create a colorless artifact token named Etherium Cell with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color."
−2: Target creature gets +X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of artifacts you control.
−7: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of combat on your turn, target artifact you control becomes an artifact creature with base power and toughness 5/5."
